apiwork.description: Building Automator, a rule-based business-process automation tool for the apimo real-estate CRM — the first slice of a strangler-fig migration from a legacy PHP platform to a modern React app.
apiwork.aboutP1: At APIWORK, I work on top of apimo, a real-estate CRM used by agencies to manage listings, clients, and daily operations. Automator layers rule-based business-process automation onto that existing platform.
apiwork.aboutP2: The project is the first slice of a strangler-fig migration: rather than a big-bang rewrite, the legacy PHP platform is being replaced piece by piece with a modern React application, starting with Automator.

0.label: AUTOMATOR
0.detail: Designed and built Automator, a rule-based business-process automation tool on top of the apimo real-estate CRM — the first slice of a strangler-fig migration from the legacy PHP platform to a modern React app.

1.label: FRONTEND REWRITE
1.detail: Led the rewrite of a legacy CRA frontend into a Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 app, embedded via iframe in the existing platform as a transitional architecture.

2.label: FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
2.detail: Architected the frontend around a Zustand wizard store, reusable components, and nested React Router layouts.

3.label: BACKEND & API GAPS
3.detail: Implemented backend logic to cover gaps in the apimo API and its database, delivering features end-to-end.

outcomes: Shipped Automator, the first strangler-fig slice migrating apimo off its legacy PHP platform onto React
Delivered a production Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 frontend embedded via iframe in the existing platform
Built a scalable frontend architecture around a Zustand wizard store, reusable components, and nested React Router layouts
Closed gaps in the apimo API and database with end-to-end backend features

nativeSpaces.description: Native Spaces is an online marketplace enabling event organisers to discover and book unique venues alongside handpicked event suppliers.
nativeSpaces.aboutP1: is an online marketplace that makes it easy for companies and individuals to book truly unique venues for events such as product launches, company seminars, photoshoots and other. The platform features a curated selection of spaces, from luxury villas and historic châteaux to hidden gardens, boats, and yachts, with options to match different styles and budgets.
nativeSpaces.aboutP2: Native Spaces also supports venue owners with underused properties by helping them showcase their spaces and connect with both national and international clients. The company handles key operational aspects, including event insurance and a secure, streamlined payment system.

0.label: V2 PLATFORM BUILD
0.detail: Built core features for the V2 marketplace — venue landing pages, blog system, and full responsive implementation across the site to name a few.

1.label: MIGRATION & NEW FEATURES
1.detail: Built V2 features in Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, tRPC, and PostgreSQL while adapting code based on V1 learnings and helping onboard the team to the new platform.

2.label: ON-SITE DEV
2.detail: Sole on-site developer in the dev team, bridging remote engineers with the on-site team for product and design decisions.

3.label: USER RESEARCH
3.detail: Gathered and synthesized user feedback to drive product decisions and validate feature direction.

outcomes: Shipped venue pages and blog system now live on the platform
Delivered full responsive implementation across the entire site
Successfully navigated V1 to V2 migration without blocking new feature work
Kept remote and on-site teams aligned on product direction

mangeBien.description: A recipe management and social discovery mobile app built with Laravel and React Native.
mangeBien.aboutP1: Mange Bien is a cross-platform mobile application that lets users discover, create, and share recipes. It combines social features like following chefs and liking recipes.
mangeBien.aboutP2: The app features user authentication, recipe creation with photos, nutritional tracking, social discovery of featured chefs, collections to organize favorites, and privacy controls to keep recipes private or share them publicly.

0.label: USER AUTHENTICATION
0.detail: Secure signup/login with token-based authentication using Laravel Sanctum and Expo Secure Store for credential storage.

1.label: RECIPE MANAGEMENT
1.detail: Create recipes with ingredients, instructions, and photos. Cloudinary integration for image uploads and storage.

2.label: SOCIAL DISCOVERY
2.detail: Browse featured chefs. Follow other users and like recipes to build your feed.

3.label: COLLECTIONS & PRIVACY
3.detail: Organize and save favorite recipes into collections. Privacy controls to keep recipes private or share publicly.

architecture: Type-safe API with validated form requests and typed TypeScript frontend
Many-to-many relationships for flexible recipe-ingredient associations with pivot data
JSON columns for storing complex nutritional data
Enum-based categorization for ingredient types (Vegetable, Fruit, Protein, Dairy, Grain, Spice)
learned: Building RESTful APIs with Laravel and consuming them in React Native
Implementing secure authentication flows for mobile apps
Managing complex database relationships (many-to-many with pivot data)
Setting up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions for both backend and mobile

conveyor.description: An IoT-powered automated conveyor belt system that scans packages via RFID and routes them to the correct warehouse.
conveyor.aboutP1: The RFID Conveyor Belt Management System is an end-to-end IoT solution that automates package sorting in a warehouse environment. An ESP8266 microcontroller reads RFID tags on packages, determines the destination warehouse, and actuates a servo-driven gate to route each package to the correct lane.
conveyor.aboutP2: The system integrates with Dolibarr ERP for inventory management and exposes a real-time Next.js dashboard for monitoring package flow, warehouse capacity, and system health. Built as a team project at Epitech, it demonstrates embedded systems and full-stack web development working together.

0.label: RFID PACKAGE SCANNING
0.detail: MFRC522 reader scans tags, extracts the product reference, and identifies the target warehouse based on the tag data.

1.label: 3-WAY AUTOMATED ROUTING
1.detail: Servo-driven gate positions at 0°, 90°, or 180° to route packages to Warehouse A, B, or C. Laser break-beam sensor detects package arrival.

2.label: ERP INTEGRATION
2.detail: ESP8266 communicates with Dolibarr ERP via REST API to create products and record stock movements automatically on each scan.

3.label: REAL-TIME DASHBOARD
3.detail: Next.js dashboard polls Dolibarr every 5 seconds to display live stats, warehouse distribution charts, scanned packages, and system health.

architecture: Three-tier architecture: embedded controller, ERP backend, and web dashboard communicating via REST APIs
Dockerized backend with Dolibarr ERP, MariaDB, and PHPMyAdmin for easy deployment and reproducibility
RFID communication with ArduinoJson for structured API payloads from the microcontroller
Real-time data visualization with Recharts and Radix UI for an accessible, responsive monitoring interface
learned: Building embedded firmware in C++ with PlatformIO and interfacing hardware peripherals (RFID, servo, laser sensors)
Designing REST API integrations between microcontrollers and enterprise software (Dolibarr ERP)
Orchestrating multi-service environments with Docker Compose for backend, database, and admin tools
Building real-time monitoring dashboards with polling strategies and data visualization libraries

alertify.description: An intelligent disaster management platform built for seismologists, meteorologists, and civil protection agencies.
alertify.aboutP1: Alertify is a professional-grade disaster management platform designed for critical infrastructure monitoring. Built as my final year project at Epitech with a 6-person cross-functional team, it demonstrates full-stack capabilities, IoT integration, and real-time systems at scale.
alertify.aboutP2: The platform combines real-time sensor data processing, predictive AI analytics, and an intuitive admin interface to help agencies predict, monitor, and respond to natural disasters. I led product design and frontend development and participated in backend architecture and iot development.

0.label: REAL-TIME ANALYTICS DASHBOARD
0.detail: Live sensor data visualization with interactive charts and metrics. Real-time updates via Socket.io for instant monitoring of environmental conditions.

1.label: INTELLIGENT ALERT SYSTEM
1.detail: Hierarchical notifications (low/moderate/critical) based on real-time sensor analysis. Push notifications for mobile and web admin platforms.

2.label: PREDICTIVE AI ENGINE
2.detail: ML-based disaster prediction. Real-time anomaly detection and risk scoring from sensor pattern analysis.

3.label: SENSOR MANAGEMENT
3.detail: Web-only configuration and monitoring of IoT devices. Track sensor health, configure thresholds, and manage device deployments.

impact: Designed for seismologists, meteorologists, and civil protection agencies to monitor critical infrastructure
Microservices architecture capable of handling real-time IoT data streams from distributed sensor networks
GDPR-compliant with security-first approach: JWT authentication, and role-based access control
methodology: Cycle en V methodology with systematic validation at each development stage
85% unit test coverage requirement with comprehensive integration testing
CI/CD via GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment
Agile sprints with ClickUp for project tracking and team coordination
